About.title: About me
About.p1: Full Stack Developer with over 5 years of experience building and scaling production web and mobile applications, designing APIs, and delivering responsive frontend experiences. I specialize in React, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS, and modern backend systems, with a track record of shipping real products across startups and established companies.

About.stack: React, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Prisma
About.p2After: . I am also experienced with React Query, Redux, Docker, and cloud deployment workflows.

dursa.title: Web Developer
description: Developed and maintained the Dursa website using Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS.
Built responsive, user-friendly, and accessible web interfaces.
Implemented new features and enhanced existing functionality based on project requirements.
Optimized website performance and improved page load speed.
Collaborated with the team to deliver high-quality, maintainable code.

mcco.title: Full-Stack Developer
mcco.description: Built and launched MCCO's official website from the ground up as the sole Full-Stack Developer. Designed the full-stack architecture using Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and MongoDB, and managed the complete application deployment, delivering a production-ready platform in under 3 months.

aseel.title: Full-Stack Developer
aseel.description: Progressed through three distinct roles at AseelApp over 12 months: started as Backend Developer building core APIs, transitioned to React Native mobile development on the Aseel Atalan app, then led frontend development on the main web platform, collaborating with cross-functional teams throughout.

blissio.title: Full-Stack Developer
blissio.description: Led the backend team at blissio.ai, architecting and shipping production APIs for the core platform. Managed application and API deployments across Azure, Google Cloud, and Digital Ocean using Docker, supported AI model integrations, and later contributed to the React Native mobile frontend.

otatickets.title: Full-Stack Developer
description: Working as a Full-Stack Developer at OtaTickets.com, contributing to the development of a complete ticket reservation and booking platform.
Developing the frontend using React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and React Query for flight search, reservation, and booking workflows.
Building backend services and APIs using NestJS, Express.js, MySQL/SQL, gRPC, and RabbitMQ to support scalable ticketing operations.
Developing and integrating APIs with external airline and travel providers for real-time schedules, availability, pricing, and booking data.
Integrating provider data from Kam Air, Ariana Afghan Airlines, and Turkish Airlines to enable up-to-date flight options and seamless reservations.

sunzalaMarketplace.title: Founder & Developer
description: Founded and independently developing a marketplace for digital and physical products.
Designing and developing the platform using Next.js, React, TypeScript, NestJS, and PostgreSQL.
Building scalable backend services and RESTful APIs for authentication, authorization, product management, orders, and user functionality.
Designing relational database schemas and implementing SQL queries, relationships, indexing, transactions, and data integrity with PostgreSQL.
Managing application architecture, deployment, infrastructure, and ongoing product development from concept to production.

profitwave360.title: Software Engineer
description: Developed and maintained the Profitwave360 website, implementing new features and improving functionality and user experience.
Improved website performance, technical SEO, and page structure to support better search visibility and organic traffic.
Built and optimized service pages, calculators, and content-focused sections while applying SEO best practices for indexing and engagement.

open.title: Open to Opportunities
open.description: Actively seeking full-time and freelance opportunities in Full-Stack, Backend, Frontend, and Database roles. Open to both remote and on-site positions worldwide.
